//: OpenCues compatibility manifest for Firefox. Firefox auto-updates itself, so we don't pin a version — we declare the minimum required (driven by the CSS Custom Highlight API). Update.cjs --check on firefox is informational only (no auto-upgrade path).
min-version-reason: CSS Custom Highlight API (Highlight, CSS.highlights) reached stable in Firefox 140.

known-incompatible.reason: CSS Custom Highlight API not available — add-on renders no highlights.
